name: Swirl
description: The picture twists into a swirl that peaks mid-way, where the first clip dissolves into the second, then untwists. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: strength
params.description: Turns of the swirl at its center at the peak (negative turns clockwise)

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the swirl, in frame heights

params.name: center
params.description: Center of the swirl (0..1, y down)
